purpose: Compare an expected Unicode-safe name with the name of one resolved current body, face, edge, or group.
trigger: Use when exactly one current target identity and its expected name are available.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: Optional live body target or owner for a face/edge target.

inputs.name: face
inputs.description: Optional live face target; body must also identify its current owner.

inputs.name: edge
inputs.description: Optional live edge target; body must also identify its current owner.

inputs.name: group
inputs.description: Optional named-group target; native group-parent identity is unverified for a DocObject parent and is not a runtime-supported target yet.

inputs.name: named_group
inputs.description: Optional group alias accepted by the action; native group-name runtime support remains unverified.

inputs.name: object
inputs.description: Optional generic target; object_kind is required unless the target is a directly typed body/face/edge/group.

inputs.name: object_kind
inputs.description: Optional kind for generic object; exactly one target identity must resolve.

inputs.name: expected_name
inputs.description: Expected Unicode-safe object name to compare.

preconditions: root is the live current root Part and exactly one root-scoped target identity resolves; body owner is supplied when needed for face/edge.
expected_name is a nonempty string and is compared without ASCII-forcing Unicode.

outputs.name: action_id
outputs.description: Literal validation action identity emitted by the script.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: Action status from the script result; no status is inferred when execution is unavailable.

outputs.name: geometry_modified
outputs.description: Always false for this read-only action.

outputs.name: gui_interaction
outputs.description: Always false; the action does not drive the GUI.

outputs.name: runtime_claim
outputs.description: Always false; the result does not by itself promote runtime evidence.

outputs.name: validation_boundary
outputs.description: Read-only current-root measurement/check boundary reported by the action.

postconditions: The name comparison is bound to the resolved current object identity and reports actual_name/expected_name/matches.
No rename or other geometry/document mutation occurs.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 action wrapper with ATOMIC_INPUT/ATOMIC_OUTPUT; runtime execution remains not_tested in this candidate.
implementation.notes: Candidate exact artifact is bound below; consult the exact-version evidence layers for tested variants. Adapt guidance object_current_name to the action's typed ATOMIC_INPUT target alternatives={body|face|edge|group|named_group|object}+root/object_kind as applicable; do not dispatch object_current_name or a name-only target. Native group/named_group target identity with a DocObject parent is unverified and unsupported for runtime claims; current runtime evidence is limited to the body-name variant. The current action's Unicode normalization is authoritative.

ambiguity_checks: Resolve the declared target from its supplied identity and semantic properties; do not use arbitrary BodyN/FaceN aliases or return order.
If the target is not unique or the current topology/view cannot be observed, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; this operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: The declared target, scope, or view identity is missing or ambiguous.
failure_modes.detection: The supplied identity does not resolve to exactly one current target.
failure_modes.safe_state: No validation action is performed and no pass claim is emitted.

failure_modes.condition: The required API, host path, controller gesture, or visible state cannot be observed.
failure_modes.detection: The adapter or controller reports unsupported/blocked/unknown state.
failure_modes.safe_state: Preserve the current document/view and return needs_manual_review or not_tested.

recovery.action: Strengthen the target identity or stop for manual review; do not substitute a numbered alias.
Use only a verified equivalent control/API or return needs_manual_review; do not repeat an unsupported gesture.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare its operation ID with the catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, candidate-only, and declares one independent validation_visual_review action.

validation.method: Compare this contract's canonical ATOMIC_INPUT/ATOMIC_OUTPUT fields with the linked action artifact and keep any conceptual guidance-to-script adaptation explicit.
validation.expected: Canonical live-object/unit/frame fields match the action boundary; guidance-only aliases are not dispatched without an adapter.

validation.method: Execute the exact linked .scscript with one injected ATOMIC_INPUT only after target identity and evidence gates pass.
validation.expected: The name comparison is bound to the resolved current object identity and reports actual_name/expected_name/matches.

evidence_level.notes: Exact V21 action run and paired synthetic assertion passed. Only declared root-scoped variant; see runtime snapshots and limitations.
